name: incident_type_common
caption: Common Incident Type
description: The controlled vocabulary for the incident_type_common attribute of Incident Report Activity (4230007). Values are append-only; renaming or removing a value is a breaking change. Crosswalk fields (apco_code, nibrs_code, nfirs_code) are structurally present but null in v0.1: they will be populated from licensed copies of APCO/NENA ANS 2.103.2, NIBRS, and NFIRS 700-series and marked verified per value in a minor release. Derived from a live 44-flag operational taxonomy running in production; see incident_type_common.md for guidance on borderline cases.

suspicious_activity.caption: Suspicious Activity
suspicious_activity.description: A person, vehicle, or circumstance observed that warrants attention but involves no confirmed offense and no confirmed unauthorized presence. Once unauthorized presence on the property is confirmed, use trespass.

trespass.caption: Trespass
trespass.description: Confirmed unauthorized presence of a person on the protected property, including refusal to leave and encampment. Distinct from suspicious_activity (presence not confirmed unauthorized) and access_violation (a control was defeated).

access_violation.caption: Access Violation
access_violation.description: An access control was circumvented or misused: tailgating, piggybacking, unauthorized credential use, or entry through a controlled portal without authorization. The defeat of the control is the defining feature, not mere presence.

insecure_opening.caption: Insecure Opening
insecure_opening.description: A door, gate, window, or other opening found unsecured (open, unlocked, or propped) with no evidence of force. Where forced entry is evident, use burglary_attempt; where the opening was damaged, consider vandalism.

theft.caption: Theft
theft.description: Confirmed taking of property, including cargo, materials, equipment, fuel, wire, or items from vehicles. An unsuccessful attempt to enter in order to steal belongs in burglary_attempt.

burglary_attempt.caption: Burglary / Forced Entry Attempt
burglary_attempt.description: Attempted or completed forced entry into a structure, enclosure, or vehicle, whether or not property was taken. Evidence of force distinguishes this from insecure_opening.

vandalism.caption: Vandalism
vandalism.description: Deliberate damage or defacement of property, including graffiti and sabotage, where taking property was not the apparent object.

disturbance.caption: Disturbance
disturbance.description: Verbal altercation, threatening or nuisance conduct, or disorderly activity without physical violence. Escalates to assault once physical contact occurs; use weapon when one is observed or mentioned.

weapon.caption: Weapon Observed
weapon.description: A weapon was observed, mentioned, or brandished. Takes precedence over disturbance or trespass classifications when present, regardless of whether another offense was completed.

assault.caption: Assault
assault.description: Physical violence against a person, from a mutual fight to a battery on staff or the public. Supersedes disturbance once contact occurs.

fire.caption: Fire / Smoke
fire.description: A fire, smoke, or combustion event of any size, confirmed or reasonably suspected.

evacuation.caption: Evacuation
evacuation.description: An evacuation or shelter-in-place of any scope, whatever the trigger.

medical.caption: Medical Emergency
medical.description: A medical emergency or injury requiring aid, from first aid rendered on site to EMS transport.

safety_hazard.caption: Safety Hazard
safety_hazard.description: An immediate hazard to persons - spill, exposed wiring, structural compromise, blocked egress - requiring prompt mitigation. Non-immediate deficiencies belong in property_maintenance.

utility_failure.caption: Utility Failure
utility_failure.description: Loss or failure of a utility (power, water, gas, communications) creating an unsafe or materially degraded condition.

property_maintenance.caption: Property / Maintenance Issue
property_maintenance.description: A non-immediate facility deficiency observed and reported: lighting out, leaks, broken fixtures or locks, sanitation, elevator faults. Immediate dangers are safety_hazard; damage done deliberately is vandalism.

security_device_fault.caption: Security Device Fault
security_device_fault.description: A security device (camera, intercom, access controller, sensor, barrier arm) found faulty, offline, or damaged. A frequent false-alarm cause; the device fault itself is the event.

parking_violation.caption: Parking Violation
parking_violation.description: A vehicle parked or stored in violation of site rules - unauthorized space, abandoned vehicle, tow-eligible condition - without damage or injury.

vehicle_incident.caption: Vehicle Incident
vehicle_incident.description: A vehicle event involving damage, injury risk, or a traffic hazard: collision, struck fixture or barrier, dangerous operation on the property. Rule violations without damage are parking_violation.

service_assist.caption: Service / Assist
service_assist.description: Routine assistance rendered to a customer, tenant, or visitor: escorts, lockouts, directions, deliveries, tenant requests. No adverse security condition is asserted.

welfare_check.caption: Welfare Check
welfare_check.description: A check on a person's wellbeing, requested or self-initiated, including unresponsive-person checks that do not become medical events.

false_alarm.caption: False Alarm / Unfounded
false_alarm.description: A signal or report investigated and determined to reflect no actual condition, where no other category applies. This classifies the unfounded outcome itself; paperwork artifacts (duplicates, tests) are administrative.

administrative.caption: Administrative
administrative.description: Documentation-only records: duplicate reports, tests, training entries, information-only notes. No field condition is asserted.

unexpected_occupancy.caption: Unexpected Occupancy
unexpected_occupancy.description: A person or activity present in a space at a time or in a manner not expected by schedule or authorization, without confirmed trespass intent - an after-hours worker, an unbadged contractor in a controlled area. Confirmed unauthorized presence is trespass.
